settings.search_language.label: Search language
settings.search_language.description: Preferred language for searches and channel browsing. May affect translated titles, descriptions, and which results YouTube returns and ranks first.
settings.playback_quality.label: Max quality
settings.playback_quality.description: Applies to newly opened videos. Auto uses the mpv YouTube profile. Resolution options set a maximum height and allow lower quality.
queue.title: Playback queue
queue.play_description: Play from the first video in one mpv window. Finished, skipped, or stopped videos leave the queue. Closing the player clears the entire queue.
queue.clear_confirm: Clear the queue and keep the current video?
queue.clear_description: Only the current video stays in the queue and keeps playing. Watch later and history will be kept.
queue.read_error: Could not read the playback queue; existing data was preserved
queue.save_error: Could not save the playback queue
queue.helper_unavailable: Queue playback requires python3 and the queue helper
queue.sync_error: Queue saved, but the active player could not be updated
queue.reset_confirm: Back up and reset the unreadable queue?
queue.reset_description: Keep the original file as a backup, create an empty queue, and stop queue playback.
queue.reset_done: Queue reset; original file backed up
queue.backup_error: Could not back up the queue; original file was preserved
